title: Gamepad/controller support with aim assist and full UI navigation
player_outcome: The whole game plays on a controller: twin-stick movement and camera, triggers for use/interact, bumpers for hotbar, aim assist on enemies, a radial or focus-based inventory/crafting/chest/shop/guide navigation, rebinding for pads, and button prompts that switch between keyboard and pad icons.
design: Joypad bindings in data/config/input.json + InputSetup; KeyBindings rebinding UI supports pads; analog look with curves/deadzones in UserSettings; aim assist (slow-down + slight magnetism to EntityPicking targets, off by default for mouse); focus navigation across every game/UI panel (FocusNeighbour/grab_focus), cursor emulation for slot grids; glyph set for prompts (generated sprites).
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
tests: InputConfig validation tests; aim-assist math tests in Core
verification: ui.cmds navigates inventory/crafting/shop via simulated joypad events
